description:
About Clark

Every audit answers one question: can I trust this? For 150 years, people have answered it by hand. Clark is changing that.

We build AI that doesn’t just assist auditors. It does the audit work itself. More than 35 CPA firms already use Clark to run audit fieldwork faster and at equal or better quality. Audit is where we start. Our mission is to build the trust infrastructure layer for the AI economy, and we’re only getting started.

We’re a small, hard-working team backed by top investors. We take ownership and judge ourselves by results. If you want to change how an entire profession works, you’ll fit in here.



The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to own how our customers deploy and use Clark, from the first technical conversation through to production. You’ll be the technical lead on your accounts: the person who understands how a firm actually runs, builds what’s needed to make Clark work for it, and brings what the field is learning back into the product.

This role is for an engineer who has already worked in front of customers and wants more ownership. You’ll write production code, lead implementations end to end, and work closely with engineering, product and the founders to shape what we build. You’ll also help set up how forward deployed engineering works at Clark as the team grows.



What You’ll Do

 - Lead customer deployments end to end, from scoping and technical discovery through to go-live and long-term adoption

 - Act as the technical point of contact for a set of CPA firms, building trust with audit partners, managers and IT teams

 - Map complex customer workflows and turn them into clear technical requirements and implementation plans

 - Design and build integrations, data pipelines and tooling that connect Clark to customer systems and data

 - Write production-quality code that ships into the core product when a customer solution should become a feature

 - Diagnose difficult issues across the stack and drive them to a fix with engineering

 - Turn patterns from the field into product feedback that shapes the roadmap

 - Create the playbooks, documentation and tooling that make every new deployment faster than the last

 - Mentor newer forward deployed engineers and help shape how the function grows



What We’re Looking For

 - 3+ years in a client-facing engineering role: forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, implementation or integration engineering, customer engineering, or technical consulting

 - A track record of owning customer deployments or technical projects end to end, not just supporting them

 - Strong coding skills in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar, with experience shipping code to production

 - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations and data work, including SQL

 - Ability to scope ambiguous problems, set expectations, and deliver against them with customers

 - Excellent communication: you can explain technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

 - Comfort managing several customers and priorities at once in a fast-moving environment

 - A strong sense of ownership and a bias toward action



Nice to Have

 - Experience deploying AI/LLM products in production, including prompt design, evaluation, or document processing

 - Background in accounting, audit, fintech, or other regulated industries

 - Experience working with enterprise customers on security, data access, or compliance requirements

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 - Early-stage startup experience, especially as one of the first people in a customer-facing technical role



What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 months, you’ll:

 - Independently lead multiple customer deployments from kickoff to production

 - Become a trusted technical partner to your customers and a go-to expert on Clark’s product and infrastructure internally

 - Ship integrations or features that unblock customers and make it into the core product

 - Build reusable tooling and playbooks that measurably reduce time-to-value for new customers

 - Influence product priorities with clear, field-informed feedback



Why Join Clark?

 - Meaningful equity ownership

 - Work directly with founders and customers

 - Help define forward deployed engineering at a fast-growing AI company

 - Deploy AI systems that change how an entire profession works

 - Small, high-talent-density team

 - Rapid career growth opportunities

 - In-person NYC culture focused on learning and execution
